answer: A head holds one method of working it has never published, and it is the only thing it cannot lend. To claim an epoch it must publish the full derivation of its answer and light a lantern from it, after which the ledger refuses any later claim whose derivation overlaps, so a method buys one payment and is spent for good. At the zenith of an epoch each lit lantern is a signal that a fresh method was burned; clones of one generator publish the same derivation and are marked together, so every extra head a farm runs must give up a different method of its own, permanently.
